tei:div.tei:p: khri skor bcu gsum gyi dud kyi grangs dang 'ja' mo 'dzin lugs yod/

swa sti/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mun sel phyir/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub 'khrungs nas/ /lo grangs sum stong nyis brgya dang*/ /dgu bcu 'das dus hor yul du/ /bsod nams chen po'i chu gter las/ /rgyal po jing gir gan zhes pa| |sa 'dzin rin chen 'khrungs par 'gyur/ /mi dbang de nas rgyal rabs lngar/ /stobs kyi 'khor lo bsgyur mdzad pa/ /se chen gan zhes grags pa des// 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul sa skya pa/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa spyan drangs nas// bcu phrag lo ni song ba'i dus/ /sa pho 'brug lo shar ba dang*/ /gong nas mngags pa'i gser yig pa/ /a kon ming gling gnyis yong nas/ /mi sde sa cha dang bcas pa/ /chen po hor gyis ming btags pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i dud drangs rtsis pa na/ /stod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum dang*/ /lha sde gzhung pa la sogs kyi/ khri stong gseb tu mi the bas/ /bod 'brog gang yod zur bzhag nas/ /dbus gtsang khri skor so so yi/ /dud grangs bcas pa 'di ltar ro/ /la stod lho pa'i dud kyi grangs/ /stong dang dgu cu rtsa dgu yin/ /la stod byang pa nyis stong dang*// nyi brgya lnga cu tham par brtsi/ /chu mig khri skor hor dud grangs/ /sum stong nyer gsum yod pa'i bar/ /zha lu khri skor sum stong dang*/ /brgyad brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis yod/ /byang 'brog khri skor rt-ing la 'byung*/ /yar 'brog khri skor khyad chos la| |leb ni bcu drug zer ba de/ /hor dud phyed dang brgyad brgya'o/ /dbus phyogs rtsa dud 'khyer lugs ni/ /'bri gung bod 'brog gnyis po la/ /sum stong brgyad brgya sum cu yod/ /tshal pa sum stong bdun brgya yin/ /phag mo gru pa nyis stong dang*/ /bzhi brgya sum cu rtsa brgyad yod/ /g.ya' bzang pa la sum stong dbang*/ /rgya ma ba dang bya yul ba/ /lnga stong dgu brgya phyed 'khyer yin/ /stag lung pa la lnga brgya dang*/ /de steng lha 'brug la sogs pas/ kha 'thor stong dang bzhi brgya yod/

/tshul 'di hor dang sa skya pa/ /yon mchod 'brel nas dbus gtsang du/ /sa brtsis byas pa'i thog mar 'dug /mnga' ris man nas zha lu yan/ /o kon mi ling zhes byas brtsis/ /de min 'bri khung yan gyi sa/ /si tu a skyid dag gis brtsis/ /de phyir sa skya'i dpon chen ni/ /zam glu gun mi dban hu'i sa/ /ming thob shākya bzang po de'i/ /deb ther shog ril can bzhin yin/ khri skor de pas dbus gtsang gi /'ja' mo 'dzin lugs 'di ltar snang*/ / lho byang mnga' ris dang bcas pas/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i 'jams chen dang*/ / gyam ring zhabs kha mar la thang*/ /ma phang me tog si tu yi/ /'jams chung rnams dang bcas pa 'dzin/ /dar lung 'ja' mo chu mig pas/ /tshong 'dus 'jams chen zha lu pas/ /steng du bya rog tshang pa'i dud/ /lnga bcu rtsa bdun brgyab nas 'dzin/ /stag 'jam yar 'brog khri skor te/ /bya rog tshang gi rta 'go ni/ /nyi shu rtsa brgyad de dang ni/ /shangs kyi chu phyogs sta mgo'i grangs/ /bcu gcig rgyab nas 'dzin pa yin/ /yas sribs 'jams chung yar 'brog pas/ /'dzin no de rnams gtsang phyogs yin/ /dbus pas 'ja' mo 'dzin lugs ni/ /go dper 'jams chen 'bri khung pa'i/ /ga ra 'ja' mo bya yul ba'i/ /steng du tshal pa'i ri rtse dud/ /phyed dang bzhi brgya bsnan pas 'dzin/ /brtsi bar 'ja' mo phag gru'i khar/ /sa stag hor dud lnga brgya dang*/ /lha sa'i drug brgya brgyab nas 'dzin/ /sha pho 'jams su gru gu sgang*/ kha rag 'brug pa 'ol kha ba/ /grwa ma thang pa bsdus nas 'dzin/ /kong 'jams g.ya' bzang pa yis 'dzin/ /chu lug 'di dag sngon dus yin/ /de rting lo grangs nyi shu'i tshe/ /me mo phag la khrims ra nas/ /dho shu a nu mkhan gnyis mngags/ /dbus gtsang sa rtsis zhib par byas/ /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/khri skor bcu gsum gyi dud grangs dang 'ja' mo 'dzin lugs/
